description.text: Core courses Principles of Education, Preschool Pedagogy, History of Education in China and foreign Countries, Approach to Preschool Educational Research, General Psychology, Preschool Children Psychology, Preschool Pedagogic Psychology, Human Anatomy and Physiology, Curriculum for Kindergarten, Kindergarten Management, Early Childhood Game, Pedagogy of Preschool Language. Objective This objective is to train students to obtain good moral characters and the solid knowledge of liberal arts and pedagogic psychology; have the comprehensive knowledge and techniques of preschool education; have strong ability to practice preschool-related teaching, research and management. After graduation, students will be able to serve as professional personnel working in various-typed children educational institutions, educational administrations, teaching and research departments and children educational industry to do children’s breeding, teaching and research, care-taking, media promotion and rehabilitation therapy. Meanwhile, students are also trained to lay for solid foundation for further advanced studies on preschool education and related specialties. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Education is granted

duration.text: The Preschool Education at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
